summary.text: A 71-year-old right-handed man became aware of right-hand muscle weakness at age 69 years and was diagnosed with ALS at age 70 years, on upper and lower motor neuron deficits and needle EMG findings. Open-nasal voice and hoarseness developed, and swallowing difficulty was among the findings at diagnosis. Laboratory data and brain and spinal MR images did not explain the symptoms.

Edaravone was administered. At age 71 years dietary intake decreased due to exacerbation of dysphagia, and he was admitted for construction of an implantable venous access port for nutrition intake. At that evaluation ALSFRS-R was 36, MWST 3a and RSST 1, %VC 84.8% and FEV1.0% 52.2% (decreased), ADL independent, and video-fluorography showed pharyngeal phase difficulty.

EEG and surface EMG were recorded during 120 volitional swallows with an average duration of 7.6 ± 3.0 s. No significant beta-band ERD was found until 3 s after swallow onset; significant ERD followed in bilateral prefrontal areas and the right premotor area at 3–4 s and in the Fp1, Fp2 and F4 channels at 4–5 s. Significant CMC was not found.

summary.text: A 64-year-old right-handed woman developed open-nasal voice and dysarthria as her first symptoms; dysphagia developed 3 months later and exacerbated. ALS was diagnosed at age 63 years, on upper and lower motor neuron deficits and needle EMG findings, with normal laboratory data, cerebrospinal fluid test and brain and spinal MR images. Edaravone was administered (60 mg/day for 14 days), and bilevel positive airway pressure was started.

She was admitted to construct a percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy because of exacerbated dysphagia. On admission she showed tongue atrophy, limited elevation and inversion of the tongue, ate pasted food because of impaired mastication and dysphagia, and had independent ADL. ALSFRS-R was 37, MWST 4 and RSST 2; %VC was 73.9% (decreased) and FEV1.0% 88.0%, and video-fluorography showed a more disturbed oral phase.

EEG and surface EMG were recorded during 89 volitional swallows with an average duration of 8.3 ± 2.9 s. Significant beta-band ERD was found in the right lateral sensorimotor area, right premotor area and bilateral temporal areas at the beginning of the swallow but was absent from 1 to 5 s after swallow onset. Significant CMC was not found.

article_limitations: Caption-layer visual status not_inspected; the three figure images were inspected in the separate visual submission.
Case 1 diagnosis timing differs in arithmetic between the abstract (2 years before the evaluation) and the case text (age 70 years at diagnosis, age 71 years at evaluation); kept as an ambiguity.
Table 1 diagnosis and edaravone rows have an empty Years cell; no time is attached to those findings except Case 2 diagnosis findings, which sit in the 0.5 year row.
Per-patient 95% confidence limits for ERD and CMC are analysis thresholds and are not recorded as observations; methods paragraphs on EEG processing and equations are not patient facts.
Discussion interpretations of ERD (cognitive compensation, tongue representation, temporal area compensation) are author hypotheses and are not recorded as findings.
The Data_Sheet_1.pdf supplement is a one-page CARE checklist (administrative) reviewed in the supplement manifest; it is not a patient data source.
Statements without a case label (adverse events during the recordings) are kept review_only; the sentences on severe dysphagia use "they" for the two patients and are copied explicitly to both.
Dysphagia onset timing for Case 1 differs between the abstract (5 months after the first symptom) and Table 1 (1.1 years); both timed facts are source_conflict review_only.

The 'no aspiration occurred' and 'no adverse events occurred' statements name no case and are review_only for both patients; 'the patients did not execute the double or more swallowing' and the discussion 'they showed severe dysphagia' (antecedent: the two ALS patients) are kept for both.
Figure 1 caption wording is garbled ('M0 is the E1 is the time to initiate swallowing'); no equivalence of M0 and E1 is recorded.
